_comment: Committed synthetic retrieval cases (B-07). Seeded by tests/test_retrieval.py::_seed_eval_course so they run on every push. Real-material validation (PDFs, OCR, unmarked proofs, tables, slides, restricted sources, large courses) and per-seam/fusion measurement on those are the residual plan-notebook gate; these establish the harness and a baseline, not broad validation.
